newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Aeroporti di Roma increases share offer.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Aeroporti di Roma increases share offer.

text.p: Italian airport operator Aeroporti di Roma (ADR), citing huge demand, said on Friday that a green shoe option had been exercised to lift the stake it had placed on the market in a public sale offer.

"The success of the bourse debut of Aeroporti di Roma was confirmed by the decision of the Global Coordinator today to exercise the green shoe, bringing the global offer from 41 to 45 percent of ADR's capital," the firm said in a statement.

It said the decision was taken after shares in the newly listed company began trade on the Milan bourse on Thursday at 14,200 lire, up 29 percent from the offer price of 11,000 lire, leading to a temporary suspension in trading.
ADR had said earlier this month that its public share offer was heavily oversubscribed and use of the green shoe option had been expected.
The statement said state holding company IRI's stake in ADR, which manages Rome's main airports, would fall to about 54 percent after the completion of the share offer. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
